intro_html: A warm, cozy curry that fills the kitchen with good smells and your fridge with easy lunches. Each bowl carries 51 grams of protein for about $4.44 a serving (at everyday cost). One skillet, 14 servings, and plenty of flavor.
cost_closing_html: About $4.44 a bowl (at everyday cost) for a high-protein dinner that beats takeout on price and macros.
portion_html: Each of the 14 bowls delivers 51 grams of protein and about 600 calories.
upsell_html: Cozy, filling, and easy on the budget, this is comfort food that loves you back. Members get every recipe in the Meal Prep section, plus the full library of money lessons and tools, all for $1 a month.
shop_smart: Grab the 8 lb ground turkey pack for the lowest price on the biggest ingredient.
A single can of coconut milk gives you that rich, creamy sauce for about two bucks, so it is worth the splurge.
Chili powder and cumin are one-jar buys that last for months, so your spice cost per batch is tiny.
make_it: Brown the ground turkey in a large skillet, breaking it up as it cooks.
Add the chopped onion and cook until soft, then stir in the chili powder and cumin.
Pour in the diced tomatoes and coconut milk and stir it all together.
Simmer 10 to 15 minutes until the sauce thickens and turns rich.
Serve the curry over cooked white rice.
